proposed_reports.title: Plan budgétaire (Budget du Québec)
proposed_reports.description: The annual multi-year Budget Plan of the Government of Quebec, presenting the fiscal framework, revenues (own-source and federal transfers), portfolio expenditures, debt service, accounting balance, Balanced Budget Act balance after Generations Fund deposits, economic outlook assumptions, and new measures. Tabled with the budget speech, typically in mid-March for the fiscal year beginning 1 April.

proposed_reports.title: Le point sur la situation économique et financière du Québec
proposed_reports.description: In-year update of Quebec's economic and financial situation, revising revenue, expenditure and deficit forecasts against the tabled Plan budgétaire, and updating the multi-year framework. Typically released in the fall (e.g., November).

proposed_reports.title: Bilan démographique du Québec
proposed_reports.publisher: Institut de la statistique du Québec
proposed_reports.description: Annual comprehensive demographic report for Quebec covering population estimates and change, natural increase (births and deaths), international and interprovincial migration, age structure, fertility and mortality. Draws on vital statistics and collaborates with Statistics Canada population estimates.

proposed_reports.title: Décret de population des municipalités
proposed_reports.publisher: Gouvernement du Québec (Conseil des ministres / Ministère des Affaires municipales et de l'Habitation)
proposed_reports.description: Annual order-in-council establishing the official population of every local municipality, northern village and borough for the application of laws, regulations and government programs. Explicitly based on estimates produced by the Institut de la statistique du Québec as of 1 July of the prior year.
proposed_reports.publication_cadence: annual (late December for the following calendar year)

proposed_reports.title: Budget de fonctionnement de la Ville de Montréal
proposed_reports.description: Annual operating budget of the City of Montreal covering local and agglomeration responsibilities, revenues (taxation, transfers including TVQ growth share, quotes-parts), expenditures, and the linked ten-year capital plan (PDI). Balanced as required by law; sets the property tax rates and service taxes for the year.
proposed_reports.publication_cadence: annual (typically December/January for the following fiscal year)

proposed_reports.title: Rapport financier consolidé (états financiers audités) de la Ville de Montréal
proposed_reports.description: Annual audited consolidated financial statements and financial accountability report of the City of Montreal, presenting operating results for tax purposes, surplus/deficit by local and agglomeration responsibilities, capital investments, debt ratios and other disclosures under Public Sector Accounting Standards.
proposed_reports.publication_cadence: annual (typically June for the prior calendar year)

proposed_reports.title: Budget de fonctionnement de la Ville de Québec
proposed_reports.description: Annual balanced operating budget of the City of Quebec, presenting revenues (taxes and compensations in lieu, transfers, services rendered, imposition of rights), expenditures, investment budget, and tax-rate decisions for the fiscal year, with reconciliation to Public Sector Accounting Standards.

proposed_reports.title: Rapport financier consolidé de la Ville de Québec
proposed_reports.description: Annual audited consolidated financial statements and complementary financial information of the City of Quebec, including results, financial position, debt, and fiscal-purpose reconciliations, prepared under Canadian Public Sector Accounting Standards.
proposed_reports.publication_cadence: annual (typically May for the prior year)

proposed_reports.title: Rapports financiers des organismes municipaux (sommation et base de données)
proposed_reports.publisher: Ministère des Affaires municipales et de l'Habitation
proposed_reports.description: Annual compilation and public release of the audited financial reports and complementary information submitted by all local municipalities, RCMs, metropolitan communities, intermunicipal boards and public transit bodies in Quebec. Includes aggregate summations by organism type and open-data extracts used for provincial monitoring and fiscal analysis.

proposed_reports.title: Manuel de la présentation de l'information financière municipale
proposed_reports.publisher: Ministère des Affaires municipales et de l'Habitation
proposed_reports.description: Authoritative provincial manual prescribing the form, content and accounting treatments for municipal financial reports and fiscal-purpose reconciliations in Quebec. Aligns presentation with Canadian Public Sector Accounting Standards while incorporating Quebec-specific legislative requirements for taxation and debt.

dependencies.basis: The statutory redistribution formula for the municipal share of TVQ growth (Volet I and Volet II) applies explicit multipliers and eligibility based on each municipality's Indice de vitalité économique (IVÉ) class, which is the ISQ product.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Une première répartition s’effectue sur la base de la population inscrite au Décret de population et de l’ indice de vitalité économique (IVÉ) de la municipalité. ... Une seconde répartition est effectuée sur la base de l’IVÉ et de l’indice d’éloignement (IÉ)

dependencies.basis: Volet I of the TVQ growth-sharing formula allocates the bulk of the envelope on the basis of the official population of each municipality as established in the annual Décret de population.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Une première répartition s’effectue sur la base de la population inscrite au Décret de population et de l’ indice de vitalité économique (IVÉ) de la municipalité.

dependencies.basis: The third volet of the municipal equalization regime makes eligibility conditional on the municipality's Indice de vitalité économique falling in the third, fourth or fifth quintile of the latest available ISQ list.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Est admissible au troisième volet du régime toute municipalité locale à l’égard de laquelle sont remplies les conditions suivantes pour l’exercice courant: ... 3 ° son indice de vitalité économique se situe dans le troisième, le quatrième ou le cinquième quintile de la dernière liste de l’indice de vitalité économique disponible.

dependencies.basis: By statute the Décret de population must be established on the basis of the population estimates produced by the Institut de la statistique du Québec; the Bilan démographique and related ISQ demographic products are the public expression of those estimates.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Le dénombrement est basé sur des estimations faites par l' Institut de la statistique du Québec en date du 1 er juillet 2025.

dependencies.basis: ISQ population estimates that feed the Décret are produced in collaboration with Statistics Canada and rest on the adjusted census counts and intercensal estimates published by StatCan.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Les estimations de la population sont produites par Statistique Canada, avec la collaboration de l’Institut de la statistique du Québec (ISQ) et de plusieurs ministères et organismes. Elles ont comme base les comptes de population des recensements

dependencies.basis: The City of Montreal's operating budget explicitly incorporates the annual amount received under the provincial TVQ growth-sharing program as a material revenue line.
dependencies.evidence_quote: 44,1 M$​ Partage de la croissance d’un point de la TVQ

dependencies.basis: Municipal financial statements in Quebec, including Montreal's audited consolidated report, are prepared in accordance with the Canadian Public Sector Accounting Standards (Normes comptables pour le secteur public).
dependencies.evidence_quote: Les organismes municipaux préparent leurs documents financiers en s’appuyant sur les Normes comptables pour le secteur public telles qu’elles sont établies par le Conseil sur la comptabilité dans le secteur public de CPA Canada.

dependencies.basis: The City of Quebec's consolidated financial statements are prepared under the Canadian Public Sector Accounting Standards (NCSP), as required for all Quebec municipal organisms and reflected in the provincial presentation manual.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Les organismes municipaux préparent leurs documents financiers en s’appuyant sur les Normes comptables pour le secteur public telles qu’elles sont établies par le Conseil sur la comptabilité dans le secteur public de CPA Canada.

dependencies.basis: The form, content, fiscal-purpose reconciliations and required schedules of every municipal financial report submitted to and compiled by MAMH are prescribed by the Manuel de la présentation de l'information financière municipale.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Le Manuel a pour but de fournir aux administrateurs municipaux et à toutes les personnes actives dans le domaine municipal les éléments de base pour assurer une présentation adéquate et uniforme de l'information financière. ... Il respecte également la présentation de l’information financière selon les formulaires prescrits par le gouvernement, notamment le rapport financier

dependencies.basis: Federal equalization payments form a material component of Quebec's total revenues in the multi-year financial framework presented in the Plan budgétaire; the budget tables and narrative report the amounts received under the federal program.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Transferts fédéraux 30 577 ... Sources: Institut de la statistique du Québec, Statistics Canada and Ministère des Finances du Québec.

dependencies.basis: The economic outlook and nominal/real GDP forecasts underlying the revenue projections in the Plan budgétaire rely on Statistics Canada provincial economic accounts and related national-accounts data, as explicitly sourced in the budget documents.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Sources: Institut de la statistique du Québec, Statistics Canada and Ministère des Finances du Québec.

dependencies.basis: ISQ demographic estimates and the Bilan démographique are anchored on the adjusted census counts from Statistics Canada's Census of Population.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Elles ont comme base les comptes de population des recensements, mais ont pour objectifs : 1) de corriger les résultats des recensements afin de tenir compte du sous-dénombrement net et des réserves partiellement dénombrées

dependencies.basis: The population levels, components of growth and intercensal estimates published in the Bilan démographique are produced jointly with, and rest on, Statistics Canada's population estimates program.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Les estimations de la population sont produites par Statistique Canada, avec la collaboration de l’Institut de la statistique du Québec (ISQ)
